demo_notice: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA — All employees, tasks, documents, and onboarding details in this dataset are fictional. This is not an official DSPAMC onboarding record. HR administrators must configure actual requirements for production use.

TPL-OB-STANDARD-001.name: Standard Employee Onboarding — DSPAMC
TPL-OB-STANDARD-001.description: DEMONSTRATION TEMPLATE — Illustrative onboarding tasks for DSPAMC. Actual requirements must be configured by authorized HR administrators.

PREBOARDING.label: Preboarding
PREBOARDING.description: Tasks to complete before your joining date.

tasks.title: Review onboarding instructions
tasks.description: Read the onboarding welcome packet and instructions sent by HR. Familiarise yourself with the schedule for your first day.

tasks.title: Submit required employment documents
tasks.description: Upload the documents requested by HR for employment verification. See your document checklist for the specific items required.

tasks.title: Review and acknowledge applicable policies
tasks.description: Review the Employee Handbook, Code of Conduct, and IT Acceptable Use Policy. Submit the signed acknowledgement form.

tasks.title: Confirm joining details with HR
tasks.description: Confirm your joining date, reporting time, and office location with your assigned HR coordinator.

tasks.title: HR: Prepare joining kit and workstation
tasks.description: HR to prepare welcome kit, ID card request, and confirm workstation assignment before joining date.

tasks.title: IT: Create system accounts
tasks.description: IT to create email, network, and system accounts for the new employee before joining date.

tasks.title: Complete joining formalities with HR
tasks.description: Submit any remaining original documents, sign the appointment letter, and complete HR joining formalities.

tasks.title: Attend orientation session
tasks.description: Attend the mandatory new employee orientation covering DSPAMC's mission, values, organizational structure, and key policies.

tasks.title: Receive assigned equipment
tasks.description: Collect or confirm receipt of your assigned laptop, access card, and any role-specific equipment.

tasks.title: Complete IT account and access setup
tasks.description: Set up email, VPN, Microsoft Authenticator 2FA, and access the ServiceHub portal. Log the completion through the IT team.

tasks.title: Review workplace and security guidelines
tasks.description: Review the workplace safety, physical security access, and emergency procedure guidelines.

tasks.title: Manager: Introduce employee to team
tasks.description: Reporting manager to introduce the new employee to their immediate team and key stakeholders.

FIRST_WEEK.label: First Week
FIRST_WEEK.description: Orientation, system access, and initial role exposure.

tasks.title: Complete assigned introductory training
tasks.description: Complete the assigned introductory training modules available on the DSP Learning Portal.

tasks.title: Meet reporting manager and team
tasks.description: Schedule and attend one-on-one introductory meetings with your reporting manager and key team members.

tasks.title: Review role-specific documentation
tasks.description: Review the role-specific process guides, team SOPs, and regulatory documentation relevant to your position.

tasks.title: Complete security awareness training
tasks.description: Complete the mandatory information security awareness training covering data handling, phishing awareness, and clean desk policy.

tasks.title: Confirm access to required internal systems
tasks.description: Verify and confirm that you have access to all systems required for your role. Raise any access issues through ServiceHub.

tasks.title: Complete assigned learning modules
tasks.description: Complete all mandatory learning modules assigned to your role on the DSP Learning Portal within your first 30 days.

tasks.title: Review role-specific processes
tasks.description: Shadow and review the core workflows and processes relevant to your role with your team and manager.

tasks.title: Attend scheduled check-ins with manager
tasks.description: Attend all scheduled check-in meetings with your reporting manager during the first 30 days.

tasks.title: Submit onboarding feedback form
tasks.description: Complete the onboarding experience feedback survey to help HR improve the onboarding process.

tasks.title: Manager: Conduct initial performance review
tasks.description: Reporting manager to conduct a 30-day initial review meeting, record observations, and submit the review form.
